name: vyxtrader-admin-tauri
description: Tauri desktop shell for the Super Admin app (app/(super-admin)/) -- core-shell slice only. Sibling to desktop-tauri/ (Client/Trading terminal) and manager-tauri/ (Broker Admin + Manager), deliberately a separate app/module per project decision, not a shared codebase. Not broker-scoped -- Super Admin lives at a fixed admin.<rootDomain> subdomain, no per-broker config needed.
